arStrings.szText: {c_important}Firewall{/c} Slows enemies within by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100|%|]{/c}. After spending {c_random}[Affix_Value_1]{/c} Mana your next {c_important}Firewall{/c} is free to cast, destroys incoming Small Missiles, and Immobilizes anything hit with the initial Cast for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds.
